forecaster_note: Thu: new mixed S swell filling in, longer period more so through the day — head high with odd bigger sets at S magnets, a few more overhead sets this arvo; onshore rest of the day. Fri: plenty of long-period S swell, head to overhead at exposures, light N/offshore AM is the clean window, NE'lies pick up. Sat: S swell eases, chest–head at S magnets, breezy N all day. Sun: waist–chest leftover S + NE wind wave, best early. — Surfline forecaster, Thu 29 Oct

wind.summary: SE onshore ~15 kph at 1pm, ESE ~17 kph through 3–5pm, easing to ~13 kph by 7pm — onshore the rest of the day. Fri: light NW/N offshore ~6 kph at dawn, NE builds 18–24 kph from noon.

shark.summary: Tagged white shark #2895 detected at the North Steyne (Manly) receiver at 10:28pm Wed (~15h ago) — the only Palm Beach → Manly detection in the last 24h. Feed is current (newest statewide detection 11:58am today); 69 real detections statewide in 24h. DPI feed returned no features. Absence of newer detections is not a guarantee — check the live map before paddling out.

days.label: Today
days.note: 1pm update: long-period S swell still building (452 kJ arvo avg, peak 515; 10s + 15s). Curl Curl S end and Long Reef up to head–overhead+ by late arvo, Dee Why chest–overhead, Manly small. BUT SE/ESE onshore 15–17 kph all afternoon — bumpy, rated poor–fair everywhere. Low tide 5:43pm. Tomorrow's dawn offshore is the better call.
days.surfline_text: New mixed shorter and longer south swell is expected. The longer swell to fill in through the day. Should be head high or so, to maybe a bit bigger at the south exposed breaks in AM. A few more OH sets into the afternoon. Small to fun size elsewhere if you want something easy going.  Clean to cleanish in the morning with light offshore to SW winds. Then more onshore the rest of the day.

days.label: Tomorrow
days.note: Long-period S swell peaks — plenty of size at S-exposed breaks, a bit straight; light N offshore AM is the cleanest window, NE picks up in the afternoon. Curl Curl S end best.
days.surfline_text: Light N to offshore winds in the morning for cleanest window of the day. Plenty of size at the south exposed breaks from long period S swell - it might be a bit straight though - find a good bank or bit of reef. More easy going at other spots but long period swell should get into most breaks.  Similar size to slightly easing into the afternoon, but NE'lies expected to pick up - south facing spots cleanest.

days.label: Weekend
days.note: S swell eases Sat but still chest–head at the S magnets; breezy N all day favours S-facing spots (Curl Curl S end), elsewhere junky. Sun smaller (waist–chest), cleanish early with NW offshore then onshore.
days.surfline_text: S swell eases back but there should be enough for chest to head high surf all day at the south magnets.  Best here with breezy N'lies all day. Other breaks more junky and wind affected.  Sun: S swell leftovers mixed with short period NE wind wave - about waist to chest high.  Cleanish in the morning with offshore winds looking likely. Then onshores and quality dropping further.
